article_context: 讨论中学生提前接触计算机科学与编程的价值：它未必直接造就程序员，却能训练问题分解与逻辑思维，并帮助学生适应数字化世界。

article.title: 阅读 Text 1 · 为什么要让孩子尽早接触编程
article.background: 讨论中学生提前接触计算机科学与编程的价值：它未必直接造就程序员，却能训练问题分解与逻辑思维，并帮助学生适应数字化世界。

sentences.en: It's true that high-school coding classes aren't essential for learning computer science in college.
sentences.zh: 诚然，要在大学学习计算机科学，高中阶段的编程课并非不可或缺。

segments.text: It's true that high-school coding classes aren't essential for learning computer science in college.

sentences.en: Students without experience can catch up after a few introductory courses, said Tom Cortina, the assistant dean at Carnegie Mellon's School of Computer Science.
sentences.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学计算机科学学院副院长汤姆·科尔蒂纳表示，没有相关经验的学生在上过几门入门课程后也能赶上来。

segments.text: Students without experience can catch up after a few introductory courses, said Tom Cortina, the assistant dean at Carnegie Mellon's School of Computer Science.

sentences.en: However, Cortina said, early exposure is beneficial.
sentences.zh: 不过，科尔蒂纳认为，尽早接触计算机科学是有益的。

segments.text: However, Cortina said, early exposure is beneficial.

sentences.en: When younger kids learn computer science, they learn that it's not just a confusing, endless string of letters and numbers - but a tool to build apps, or create artwork, or test hypotheses.
sentences.zh: 孩子年纪较小时学习计算机科学，会明白它并不只是令人困惑、没完没了的字母和数字，而是一种可以用来开发应用、创作艺术作品或检验假设的工具。

segments.text: When younger kids learn computer science, they learn that it's not just a confusing, endless string of letters and numbers - but a tool to build apps, or create artwork, or test hypotheses.

sentences.en: It's not as hard for them to transform their thought processes as it is for older students.
sentences.zh: 相比年龄更大的学生，他们改变思维方式没那么困难。

segments.text: It's not as hard for them to transform their thought processes as it is for older students.

sentences.en: Breaking down problems into bite-sized chunks and using code to solve them becomes normal.
sentences.zh: 把问题拆成一个个小块，再用代码逐一解决，会逐渐成为自然的思考方式。

segments.text: Breaking down problems into bite-sized chunks and using code to solve them becomes normal.

sentences.en: Giving more children this training could increase the number of people interested in the field and help fill the jobs gap, Cortina said.
sentences.zh: 科尔蒂纳说，让更多孩子接受这种训练，可能会增加对这一领域感兴趣的人数，并有助于弥补就业岗位的人才缺口。

segments.text: Giving more children this training could increase the number of people interested in the field and help fill the jobs gap, Cortina said.

sentences.en: Students also benefit from learning something about coding before they get to college, where introductory computer-science classes are packed to the brim, which can drive the less-experienced or -determined students away.
sentences.zh: 学生在进入大学前先了解一些编程也会受益，因为大学里的计算机科学入门课往往人满为患，这可能会把经验较少或意志不够坚定的学生挤出这个领域。

segments.text: Students also benefit from learning something about coding before they get to college, where introductory computer-science classes are packed to the brim, which can drive the less-experienced or -determined students away.

sentences.en: The Flatiron School, where people pay to learn programming, started as one of the many coding bootcamps that's become popular for adults looking for a career change.
sentences.zh: Flatiron School 是一所收费教授编程的学校，起初只是众多编程训练营中的一家，而这类训练营后来在寻求转行的成年人中日益流行。

segments.text: The Flatiron School, where people pay to learn programming, started as one of the many coding bootcamps that's become popular for adults looking for a career change.

sentences.en: The high-schoolers get the same curriculum, but "we try to gear lessons toward things they're interested in," said Victoria Friedman, an instructor.
sentences.zh: 高中生学习同样的课程，不过教师维多利亚·弗里德曼说：“我们会尽量让课程贴近他们感兴趣的东西。”

segments.text: The high-schoolers get the same curriculum, but "we try to gear lessons toward things they're interested in," said Victoria Friedman, an instructor.

sentences.en: For instance, one of the apps the students are developing suggests movies based on your mood.
sentences.zh: 例如，学生正在开发的一款应用会根据用户的心情推荐电影。

segments.text: For instance, one of the apps the students are developing suggests movies based on your mood.

sentences.en: The students in the Flatiron class probably won't drop out of high school and build the next Facebook.
sentences.zh: Flatiron 课程里的学生大概不会因此高中辍学，然后打造出下一个 Facebook。

segments.text: The students in the Flatiron class probably won't drop out of high school and build the next Facebook.

sentences.en: Programming languages have a quick turnover, so the "Ruby on Rails" language they learned may not even be relevant by the time they enter the job market.
sentences.zh: 编程语言更新换代很快，所以等他们进入就业市场时，所学的“Ruby on Rails”甚至可能已经不再重要。

segments.text: Programming languages have a quick turnover, so the "Ruby on Rails" language they learned may not even be relevant by the time they enter the job market.

sentences.en: But the skills they learn - how to think logically through a problem and organize the results - apply to any coding language, said Deborah Seehorn, an education consultant for the state of North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 但北卡罗来纳州教育顾问德博拉·西霍恩表示，他们学到的能力——如何用逻辑思维分析问题、如何组织结果——适用于任何编程语言。

segments.text: But the skills they learn - how to think logically through a problem and organize the results - apply to any coding language, said Deborah Seehorn, an education consultant for the state of North Carolina.

sentences.en: Indeed, the Flatiron students might not go into IT at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，Flatiron 的学生将来甚至可能根本不会进入信息技术行业。

segments.text: Indeed, the Flatiron students might not go into IT at all.

sentences.en: But creating a future army of coders is not the sole purpose of the classes.
sentences.zh: 但培养一支未来的程序员大军并不是这些课程唯一的目的。

segments.text: But creating a future army of coders is not the sole purpose of the classes.

sentences.en: These kids are going to be surrounded by computers - in their pockets, in their offices, in their homes - for the rest of their lives.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子余生都会被计算机包围——口袋里、办公室里、家里都会有。

segments.text: These kids are going to be surrounded by computers - in their pockets, in their offices, in their homes - for the rest of their lives.

sentences.en: The younger they learn how computers think, how to coax the machine into producing what they want - the earlier they learn that they have the power to do that - the better.
sentences.zh: 越早学会理解计算机如何“思考”、如何引导机器做出自己想要的结果，越早意识到自己拥有这种驾驭机器的能力，就越好。

segments.text: The younger they learn how computers think, how to coax the machine into producing what they want - the earlier they learn that they have the power to do that - the better.
